headline: Franklin built an approval-gated research handoff that keeps outreach and CRM writes under human control.

what_changed.summary: Added a source-backed lead packet validator.

why_it_matters: This gives Agentic-Hub a practical pattern for AI-assisted research with auditability.
public_safe_case_study: For Agentic-Hub, Franklin created a lightweight contract where research outputs are validated and imported into pending review before a named human decision.
risk_notes: No private client data is disclosed.
